Surat: CBIC moves the customs zone for rough diamonds into the Surat Diamond Bourse itself.

સુરત: CBICએ કાચા હીરાની કસ્ટમ ઝોનને સુરત ડાયમંડ બુર્સમાં જ સરકાવ્યું.

A Special Notified Zone that lets manufacturers view, auction and clear imported rough diamonds moves from Ichhapore into the bourse's own Surat International Diatrade Centre, India's second such zone, per a CBIC circular dated 28 September.

Mumbai: a gold-chain manufacturer that supplies Titan and Kalyan Jewellers files a Rs1,000-crore IPO.

મુંબઈ: ટાઇટન અને કલ્યાણ જ્વેલર્સને સપ્લાય કરતી ગોલ્ડ ચેઇન બનાવતી કંપનીએ 1,000 કરોડનો IPO ફાઇલ કર્યો.

Royal Chain's draft prospectus splits the Rs1,000-crore issue into an Rs850-crore fresh share sale and an Rs150-crore stake sale by its promoters. The company makes over 27,000 jewellery designs at its Mahape plant near Mumbai.
